publications.abstract: We report the prior identification of late-time mid-infrared rebrightening in SN 2020jfv and SN 2020izc with WISE/NEOWISE, more than two years before their optical rebrightening in LSST EDP2. Persistent MIR emission beyond 1000 days, together with late-time Hα emission in SN 2020izc and UV excess in SN 2020jfv, confirms ongoing circumstellar-medium interaction. These results demonstrate the power of infrared selection for identifying long-lived interacting supernovae and motivate continued late-time IR monitoring in the LSST era.

observations.summary: IceCube-250813A - IceCube observation of a high-energy neutrino candidate track-like event

publications.abstract:
The IceCube Collaboration (http://icecube.wisc.edu/) reports:
On 2025-08-13 03:21:09.69 UT IceCube detected a track-like event with a moderate probability of being of astrophysical origin. The event was selected by the ICECUBE_Astrotrack_Bronze alert stream. The average astrophysical neutrino purity for Bronze alerts is 30%. This alert has an estimated false alarm rate of 2.0759 events per year due to atmospheric backgrounds. The IceCube detector was in a normal operating state at the time of detection.
